3. Worked Example / Step-by-Step Scenario

← 2. Theoretical Framework & Formali…·4. Active Recall Quizzes →

Step 1: Setup
Formulating the Problem

"Rain shelters for bus stops (monsoon city!): (a) two tool picks + sparks? (b) One transplant + boundary? (c) Six-lens lightning verdicts? (d) PoC question?"

Step 2: Execution
Sprint Answers
  1. (a) SCAMPER (Combine shelter+vendor-kiosk! Eliminate side-panels for visibility-safety!) + hats trio (safety-black first!).
  2. (b) Metro-station canopies → stop shelters: mechanism (cantilevered spans!) + boundary (transit-agency maintenance regimes differ!).
  3. (c) Tech PASS / econ PASS-conditional (per-stop capex!) / market PASS (riders!) / ops CONCERN (cleaning rota!) / legal PASS (ROW permits!) / ethical PASS + (lighting-safety bonus!).
  4. (d) "Do lit shelters change night-boarding behaviour?" (behavioural unknown first — structures follow proof!).
Step 3: Conclusion
Final Result

Tools-to-verdicts-to-PoC-question sprint completeness. Behavioural-unknown-first (people-proof before concrete!) is the seasoned ordering.

Q1: Mixed Drill +10 XP

Six hats on a solo founder (no team). Adaptation?

💡 Pedagogical Insight
Click to view/hide ▾

Solo-hatting protocol (timed forced-modes + written traces!) preserves parallel-thinking benefits minus group friction. Structure-scales-down (rituals > headcounts!) is the facilitation insight.

</div>
Q2: Mixed Drill +10 XP

SWOT vs decision matrix placement (both analytical!): when which?

💡 Pedagogical Insight
Click to view/hide ▾

Audit-then-verdict sequencing (terrain before scoring!) — premature matrices score fog (criteria float without landscape!). Stage-matched tooling (map-then-measure!) orders analysis.

</div>
Q3: Mixed Drill +10 XP

Feasibility says market-PASS but ops-KILL (no maintainer exists). Verdict?

💡 Pedagogical Insight
Click to view/hide ▾

Veto-honouring (red is red!) with design-around optionality (invent maintenance, then re-verdict!). Averaging-vetoes fallacy named and refused — governance spine intact.
